About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

  • Develop creative ideas and concepts aligned with Mistral’s brand strategy, audience insights, and business objectives.

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

jobs.title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
jobs.jd:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact. National Security is a significant sector for Plexal’s Innovation Services business, where we enable our government clients’ adoption of new technology and create innovation ecosystems to enable their adaptation to the opportunity of disruptive and emerging technology. 
 
The Senior Customer Lead National Security is responsible for leading engagement with Plexal’s National Security clients in London and the adjacent region, building strategic partnerships to grow Plexal’s National Security business in region, evolving Plexal’s propositions and client offering in this market, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and success. This role sits in the wider National Security and Defence team, supporting the whole lifecycle of client engagement and delivery.  
 
The successful candidate will combine commercial capacity with government insight, helping Plexal to understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.


What You'll Do

  • Act as account lead for Plexal’s National Security clients located in London and the wider region, ensuring strong, resilient partnerships through the whole life cycle of Plexal’s client engagement from prospecting, proposal development, opportunity identification, and customer satisfaction in project delivery.   • Utilise engagement on client delivery to build highly effective client relationships that support Plexal’s account objectives.

jobs.title: Bilingual Customer Success Account Manager, SMB (German, French, or Spanish)
jobs.jd:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

Hiya is growing its SMB customer base across the UK and Europe, and this role exists to ensure those customers stay, grow, and succeed.

This role sits within Hiya Connect - our branded calling product. Hiya Connect Branded Call enables businesses to display their verified brand name, logo, and call reason on outbound calls, helping customers recognize trusted calls, increase answer rates, and improve engagement.

As a Bilingual Customer Success Account Manager, SMB, you’ll own a high-volume portfolio of 300+ customers. You’ll make commercial decisions every day about how to prioritise your time, engage customers, and create growth across your book of business. The pace is fast and the portfolio is broad.
